title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Join our BPO center as a Customer Service Representative. Key Responsibilities:
- Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat.
- Resolve customer issues promptly and professionally.
- Provide product information and support.
- Accurately document customer interactions in the CRM system.
Requirements:
- High school diploma or equivalent.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
- Ability to remain calm and empathetic under pressure.
- Basic computer and typing skills.
